hardware: 1 node x 16 Ascend 910B (64 GiB), 180 CPU, quota row 16,180,1800
change: models/generator_wan21.py packed_attention and models/vision_encoder.py VisionAttention attend to every packed segment in one varlen call (ops.attention.varlen -> npu_fusion_attention TND) instead of looping once per visual/image
configuration: 8 packs/card, global batch 128, seq 8192, full recompute, keep-attention-activations 6, wide loader (--data-workers 8 --image-workers 12 --image-prefetch 48 --data-prefetch 24)

numerical_gate.method: three-way: FP64 CPU oracle, BF16 device per-segment loop (the implementation in use until now), BF16 device varlen. The new form must not be further from the oracle than the loop. Forward and all three gradients.
numerical_gate.note: the loop-vs-varlen gradient disagreement is ~0.3% of BF16's own error against the oracle; both forms are equally far from FP64

cpu_tests.new: tests/test_varlen_attention.py, 14 tests, FP64 bit-exact against a locally re-implemented loop oracle
cpu_tests.pre_existing_failures: this venv's transformers does not recognize model type qwen3_5; HF now returns a tuple where the test expects pooler_output

dispatch_census_per_step.caveat: pack contents differ between the two census runs (images per pack varies), so per-file deltas carry data noise; distributed/megatron.py and ops/functional.py read higher after. The op_statistic launch counts above are the cleaner measure.

device_occupancy.reading: the launch-bound idle this change targeted is gone (free 18.5 s -> 2.6 s). Non-overlapped communication rose in its place. Not separated: HCCL waits for the slowest rank, and data_wait spiked to 11-25 s on several steps in the same run, so most of that 10.4 s is most likely rank skew from the host pipeline rather than genuine transport cost.

wall_time.verdict: no reliable wall-clock win yet. The same loader settings that kept the pre-change run fed (data_wait median 0.02 s) no longer keep up: compute got 26% faster, so the host pipeline became the binding constraint again.

fed_steps_only.caveat: n=3. Indicative only; a longer fed run is needed before this number is used.

operator_paths.note: the backbone keeps the CQ-mask tiled path; the DiT and vision towers now take the varlen path

not_measured: a long fed run with a wider loader (the number that would settle the wall-clock gain)
whether the 10.4 s non-overlapped communication is rank skew or real transport
the same change on CUDA (L40S still runs the per-segment loop; this commit does not alter CUDA behaviour)
